module_summary: PS/2 message framer: a 4-state FSM syncs on bytes with in[3]=1, counts three bytes and asserts done after the third.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: BYTE1/BYTE2/BYTE3/DONE framing state; decoded to done.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: One-cycle message-received pulse when FSM reaches DONE.

anchors.name: in3
anchors.why: Bit 3 of input byte marking a message start; steers BYTE1 and DONE transitions.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: Input byte stream; only bit 3 is examined.

groups.name: Message framing FSM
groups.description: Byte-count state machine synchronized on in[3]; done decode.
